_comment: Forms proposed for config/figure-forms.json, for figure notes the Wordplay thread hands to the Layers thread. The Layers thread's branch claude/layers-figure-forms (a21b8f9, wip) already adds 17 forms; these three are the ones it does not have, in its style. Map for notes written with this thread's working ids: doubling and irony are the same ids there.

defined: Bullinger's own words, found word for word in the UniqueBible.app module of the 1898 text; at and url give the printed page, which is the archive.org leaf minus 54 (the offset that holds through the book). _page says whether a second reader saw a search hit on that leaf; _examples are the first verses Bullinger lists. Fields starting with _ are working notes, not for the build.

forms.label: A picture left unexplained
forms.about: A picture is named and the thing it stands for is left for the hearer to see.

defined.quote: A Declaration that implies the Resemblance or Representation; or Comparison by Implication
defined.read: the UniqueBible.app module of the 1898 text, at github.com/darrelwright/UniqueBible_Books (commit 4017a67)

forms._page: leaf minus 54, with a search-inside hit on that leaf

forms.label: A to Z
forms.about: Lines or verses begin with the letters of the Hebrew alphabet in order.
